limits: This observation describes the published v0.10.10 release and its deployed server, not later main commits.
This tagged workflow used the release gates present at its source commit. Later restored account daemon, unified, portable and agents gates are outside this release evidence.
Later terminal Requests/read-summary changes and the separately tested 182-assertion daemon migration are not claimed as part of this deployed version.
Homepage HTML differs between the direct and public surfaces; identical fingerprinted asset bytes were verified.
All production actions in this observation were read-only; no deployment, restart, configuration change or workflow rerun was performed.
